title: Building metadata (fet3d.building/1)
description: metadata of the Geometry job output with artifactType building_metadata, sent beside preview_glb in the same attempt (Docs ifc_ingestion_visual_interaction.md 5.7). The backend validates interactables field by field and serves them as equipment candidates (IFC-04); other sections only need their container shape. An interactable's ifcGlobalId should also appear in preview_glb semanticMapping so the editor can use it as anchorId.

sources.description: Provenance of each IFC file: role (architecture, mep, plumbing, fire), sha256, IFC schema, exporting application.

spaces.description: IfcSpace data: ifcGlobalId, name, longName (Revit puts the room name here), category, storey, bbox.

id.description: Stable candidate id, unique in the artifact, e.g. ifc:<GlobalId>.

catalogKey.description: Capability id of the interaction catalog, e.g. extinguisher.portable, water.sink.

source.description: ifc: found as an element; inferred: derived (for example an exit door on an outer wall).

confidence.description: Below 0.9 the candidate is listed as needing confirmation.

confirmedBy.description: Reserved; confirmations are stored by the backend, never in the artifact.

position.description: [x, y, z] metres in the floor frame.
